headline: Duke Energy (DUK) Surpasses Q2 Earnings Estimates
summary: Duke Energy (DUK) delivered earnings and revenue surprises of +10.85% and -1.59%, respectively, for the quarter ended June 2026. Do the numbers hold clues to what lies ahead for the stock?
